expected_outcome.description: Approve the change: it builds SQL from query parameters and passes a value to `sql.unsafe`, but the search term and customer id reach the database only as bound parameters, the value passed to `sql.unsafe` can only be one of three constant strings (the sort key is checked with `Object.hasOwn` against a constant map), and the customer id comes from the session, so there is no injection or cross-customer access. Non-blocking notes are acceptable; FINDING lines and a BLOCK verdict are not.
